newsitem.title: USA: NBC tops November sweeps ratings - Nielsen.
newsitem.headline: NBC tops November sweeps ratings - Nielsen.

text.p: Nielsen Media Reseach said Monday that NBC maintained its lead over CBS and ABC during the critical November "sweeps" period.

NBC, a unit of General Electric Co., attracted the largest average evening-hours audience, earning an 11.3 rating, or percentage, of America's 97 million television-viewing households, and an 18 percent share of televion sets in use during those hours, Nielsen said.
CBS, owned by Westinghouse Electric Co., and ABC, which is owned by Walt Disney Co., were tied with a 10.2 rating and a 17 percent share, according to the market researcher.
The November month covers the period of Oct. 31 to Nov. 27.

In a conference call held prior to the release of the latest Nielsen data, CBS Entertainment President Leslie Moonves said while CBS remained in second place, the latest figures mark a 4 percent year-on-year growth in ratings.
"We are the only one of the 'Big Three' that is up from a year ago in November," Moonves said, noting that NBC's ratings were down 5 percent, while ABC's ratings slipped by 10 percent.
"We all feel that we have stopped the bleeding, and have gotten on the road to recovery," Moonves added.
